description: Machine-readable support registry (Audit1 WI-4.1). Single source of truth for the supported model envelope: supported_models(), the migration vignette table, and the consistency tests in test-model-support.R are all derived from or checked against this file. Editing the wrapper's support surface without updating this registry fails the suite.

glmm_families.notes: Bernoulli 0/1, cbind(successes, failures), and proportion + trial weights responses.
NB2 via mm_negative_binomial(); theta estimated or fixed. Intervals via confint(method = "bootstrap").

features.notes: GLMM binomial weights double as trial counts for proportion responses.
lmm() has no offset argument; glmm(offset =) is supported.
GLMM simulation is not implemented in this version.
Refit GLMMs by calling glmm() on the modified data.

features.feature: subset / random / custom na.action / custom contrasts (GLMM)
features.notes: Reserved arguments on glmm(); recode data before fitting. LMMs: default refuses NA unless na.action = na.omit; non-default contrast codings are refused at compile time.

features.feature: marginal means verbs (mm_means / mm_comparisons / mm_grid / mm_predictions / test_effect)
features.notes: GLMM marginal means go through the emmeans bridge on certified fits.

mixeff fixes every covariance in the block at zero, including among a factor's level contrasts (matching MixedModels.jl zerocorr()); lme4's || leaves factor terms intact. Announced at compile time (covariance_assumption / double_bar_factor_term); the migration vignette gives the lme4-equivalent expansion.

non_goals: arbitrary GLM family objects or custom links
adaptive Gaussian quadrature as a general estimator contract (nAGQ > 1 is a profiled-path sensitivity mode)
